tasks.title: House to sword — 5-run checkout
tasks.x: Tap L2 after the house exit, each of two successful urchin shield bumps, the beach entry, and the sword pickup.
tasks.y: Tap R2 only after real damage, a wrong turn, a collision, or the recovery that follows it.
tasks.goal: Complete five runs from Marin's house to the sword. Each accepted run requires two clean urchin shield bumps; use X to discard a bad attempt.
